title: HSBC Maintains Reduce Rating on CoreWeave Citing $51B Debt

tickers.name: CoreWeave, Inc. Class A Common Stock

summary:
A $39 price target issued by HSBC implies that CoreWeave's shares could drop by 36%. The bank maintained its Reduce rating on the AI infrastructure provider, forecasting that its return on invested capital from 2026 to 2030 will average 8.9%, a figure that falls below the company's cost of borrowing.

CoreWeave currently carries more than $51 billion in debt while facing a slowdown in AI revenue growth. HSBC warned that continued spending under these conditions could destroy shareholder value due to growing structural fears.
